sentence: Never serve your sigmuff whole to someone who goes croggy under pressure.

wombos.definition: Tough and rough in a sigma way — so lone-wolf independent that it comes across as gruff and unpolished. 'The rizzonance coming off him was sigmuff after he ate that burger.'
The contradictory state of something that was once crunchy but has become soggy — typically food that has been sauced or dipped until its texture is an uncomfortable mix of both. A type of oron.
wombos.example: I left the chicken in the sauce too long and now it's fully croggy.
